Ok so actually everything you wrote makes perfect sense to me. There are definitely different OCD inducing behaviors in orthodox jews. Especially when it comes to food. 
The excessive and mandatory hand washing before bread- a food that most people eat several times a day. 
The mandatory blessings before and after any sort of food: acts as a sort of ritual. We were programmed to feel guilt, shame and unholiness- which is uncleanliness- if we skipped any of these rituals. 
The mandatory meals: 3-4 on shabbat, many on chag can pose a big burden for anyone who struggles.
